file_id: Radison Blue Hotel Metropolis vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 10 August, 2015

sentences.text:
Radison Blue Hotel Metropolis vs State Of Uttarakhand And
Others on 10 August, 2015

Author: Sudhanshu Dhulia
Bench: Sudhanshu Dhulia
 In The High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 Criminal Writ Petition No. 923 of 2015
Radison Blue Hotel Metropolis ... Petitioner
 Vs
State of Uttarakhand & others ... Respondents
Mr. Bhupesh Kandpal, Advocate, present for the petitioner.

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. P.S. Saun, learned Deputy Advocate General, Ms. Sruti Joshi, learned Brief Holder,
present for the State.
The petitioner is aggrieved by an order dated 30.06.2015 passed by the Adjudicating Authority under the provision of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Hence he filed the present writ petition.

2. This writ petition cannot be heard at this stage, as the petitioner has an alternative remedy provided under the Statute in Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 to file an appeal before the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal.
3. In view of the above fact, this writ petition is hereby dismissed on the ground of alternative remedy.

(Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 10.08.2015 Aswal Radison Blue Hotel Metropolis vs State Of Uttarakhand And Others on 10 August, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131149236/
